    readonly running: boolean;
    readonly inputUnavailable?: string;
    readonly pending?: {
        readonly blocking?: boolean;
        readonly kind: "input" | "action";
        readonly requestId: string;
        readonly message: string;
        readonly check: MwSubtaskAction;
    };
}

export declare function renderSwitch(options: {
    name?: string;
    checked?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    label?: string;
    className?: string;
    attrs?: Record<string, AttrValue>;
}): string;

export declare function renderTable(options: {
    head: ReadonlyArray<string>;
    rows: ReadonlyArray<ReadonlyArray<string>>;
    className?: string;
}): string;

export declare function renderTaskAttemptBudget(options: MwTaskAttemptBudgetOptions): string;

export declare function renderTextarea(options?: MwInputOptions & {
    rows?: number;
}): string;

export declare function renderToast(options: {
    message: string;
    tone?: MwTone;
    action?: {
        label: string;
        attrs?: Record<string, AttrValue>;
    };
    className?: string;
    attrs?: Record<string, AttrValue>;
}): string;

export declare function renderToggle(options: {
    label: string;
    pressed?: boolean;
    className?: string;
    attrs?: Record<string, AttrValue>;
}): string;

export declare function resolveFontScheme(spec: UiSpecFile, baseline: UiFontSchemeFile, scheme?: UiFontSchemeFile): UiFileResult<UiResolvedFont>;

export declare function resolveSkin(spec: UiSpecFile, baseline: UiSkinFile, skin?: UiSkinFile): UiFileResult<UiResolvedSkin>;

export declare function resolveUiEnvironment(input: UiEnvironmentInput): UiEnvironmentSnapshot;

export declare function ringSegmentPath(points: number[][]): string;

export declare function sandboxHelpDeclarationProblems(contract: Pick<SandboxPluginContract, "pluginId" | "help" | "ui">): string[];

export declare const say: UiSayTool;

export declare function skinTokenDeclarations(skin: UiResolvedSkin, select?: SkinTokenSelection): string;

export declare function stateRingFamily(state: StateRingState): StateRingFamily;

export declare function stateRingGeometry(id: StateRingFamily, t: number, progress?: number): RingSegment[];

export declare const t: UiTextTool;

export declare function takeWordsInPlace(current: Element, next: Element): Element;

export declare function textArgs(args: TextArgs): TextArg[];

export declare const textKeyPrefix: (owner: string) => string;

export declare function textRefProblems(value: unknown, check?: TextRefCheck): readonly string[];

export declare function tryOwnedTextRef(ref: unknown, owner: string): OwnedTextRef | null;

export declare function tryUiText(key: string, args?: TextArgs): string | undefined;

export declare function uiHelpDeclarationProblems(manifest: Pick<PluginManifest, "plugin_id" | "ui">): string[];

export declare function withDevicePreferences(snapshot: UiEnvironmentSnapshot, device: UiDevicePreferences): UiEnvironmentSnapshot;

// Declarations the exports above refer to, which no entry exports itself:

type Attrs = Record<string, AttrValue>;

type DirectoryWordManifest = NameFields & {
    readonly ui?: Pick<PluginManifest["ui"], "locales" | "views">;
    readonly artifacts?: Pick<PluginManifest["artifacts"], "produces">;
};

type Locale = string | undefined;

type MwControlSize = "sm" | "md" | "lg";

interface MwInputOptions {
    name?: string;
    type?: string;
    value?: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    required?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    invalid?: boolean;
    id?: string;
    describedBy?: string;
    size?: MwControlSize;
    className?: string;
    attrs?: Record<string, AttrValue>;
}

type NameFields = Pick<PluginManifest, "plugin_id" | "name_text" | "summary_text" | "connection_services" | "databases"> & {
    readonly permissions?: PluginManifest["permissions"];
    readonly read_groups?: PluginManifest["read_groups"];
    readonly actions?: PluginManifest["actions"];
    readonly overview_projection?: PluginManifest["overview_projection"];
};

interface PresentationControl {
    readonly key: string;
    readonly label: string;
    readonly primary?: boolean;
    readonly consequence?: readonly SurfaceConsequence[];
}

interface RingSegment {
    points: number[][];
    alpha: number;
    z: number;
    tone: string;
}

type TerminalAxis = "unset" | "light" | "dark";
